featured.name: AegisScan
featured.tagline: All in one AI correlated cybersecurity scanner
featured.summary: Multi layer security scanner covering web apps, APIs, networks and configurations, fused with intelligent AI correlation so signal beats noise.
featured.problem: Security teams drown in scanner output. Five tools produce five disjoint reports, and the actual exploit chain hides between them. Triaging that manually wastes the first hour of every incident.
featured.approach: AegisScan runs web, API, network, and configuration scanners in one pass, then pipes their findings into an LLM backed correlation layer that clusters related signals into a single attack story. Each finding lands with severity, evidence, and a remediation hint.
highlights: Multi layer scanning: web app, API, network, configuration
AI correlation engine that groups related findings into one incident
Severity scoring and remediation guidance per cluster
Built for both quick assessments and deep audits
outcomes: Cuts triage time by combining five tool outputs into one ranked feed
Maps related findings into a single exploit narrative
Reduces false positive fatigue through cross tool corroboration

featured.name: Real Time Threat Detection
featured.tagline: ML driven multi cloud SOC pipeline
featured.summary: A production grade detection system that streams events from AWS and Azure into ML models to flag threats in real time across both clouds.
featured.problem: Most SOC tooling treats AWS and Azure as separate worlds. Attackers don't. They pivot. We needed a single pipeline that ingested both clouds and learned what normal looks like.
featured.approach: Built a streaming ingest from CloudTrail and Azure Monitor into a feature pipeline, trained anomaly and classification models on labelled events, and exposed alerts through a unified API so SOC analysts see one queue, not two.
highlights: Unified AWS and Azure event ingestion
Trained anomaly and classification models on labelled security events
Real time alerting with severity and source cloud tagging
Designed for SOC analyst workflows, not just dashboards
outcomes: Detects cross cloud attacker pivoting in a single queue
Reduces dwell time by surfacing anomalies as they happen
Provides labelled training pipeline for continued model tuning

featured.name: AI Security Analyst
featured.tagline: Multi agent SOC assistant powered by Gemini
featured.summary: A multi agent cybersecurity system that automates log analysis, anomaly detection, threat intel lookup, response recommendations, and incident report generation.
featured.problem: A junior analyst spends 80% of their day on the boring 80%: correlating logs, looking up IOCs, writing the same report. The work scales linearly with alert volume, and burnout follows.
featured.approach: Built specialised agents (log parser, anomaly detector, threat intel, responder, reporter) coordinated via an orchestrator. Each agent has a narrow scope and a tool surface. FastAPI exposes the system as an API. A CLI batches it across thousands of logs.
highlights: Specialised agents for log analysis, anomaly detection, threat intel, response, reporting
Async FastAPI deployment for real time queries
Batch CLI for processing historical logs at scale
Generates analyst ready incident reports
outcomes: Automates the long tail of L1 SOC work
Produces consistent incident reports without human drafting
Frees senior analysts for actual threat hunting

featured.name: Autonomus
featured.tagline: Detect, remediate and prove cloud compliance autonomously
featured.summary: A production grade platform that autonomously detects compliance drift across cloud environments, remediates it, and produces audit ready evidence.
featured.problem: Compliance teams ship spreadsheets. Engineering teams ship infrastructure. The gap between what the policy says and what the cloud actually looks like is where audits fail.
featured.approach: Continuously scans cloud accounts against policy as code rules, auto remediates safe deltas like open S3 buckets, dangling IAM, public security groups, and bundles every action into an immutable audit trail that satisfies the standard.
highlights: Policy as code compliance scanning across AWS and Azure
Safe by default auto remediation with explicit allow list
Immutable audit trail of every detection and fix
Designed to satisfy real audit frameworks, not just produce alerts
outcomes: Closes the gap between written policy and actual cloud state
Turns compliance from a quarterly fire drill into a continuous baseline
Produces the evidence auditors actually want

featured.name: Automated ETL for Financial Analytics
featured.tagline: Production ETL across fifteen plus financial data sources
featured.summary: A production ready ETL pipeline for financial analytics with fifteen plus data sources, automated validation, transformation, and orchestration.
featured.problem: Finance teams stitched data from fifteen vendors with brittle Excel macros. Errors compounded by month end and reporting accuracy slipped.
featured.approach: Built a modular pipeline. Each source as a plug in adapter, each transform as a tested step, each load as an idempotent write. Validation gates between every stage stop bad data from poisoning downstream reports.
highlights: Fifteen plus financial data sources unified under one ingestion layer
Validation gates between extract, transform, load
Idempotent loads, safe to re run on partial failure
Orchestration with retry, alerting, and lineage
outcomes: Cut reporting time from hours to minutes
85% improvement in data refresh reliability
Validation catches bad source data before it hits dashboards

featured.name: Power BI Executive Dashboard
featured.tagline: C suite KPIs with predictive analytics
featured.summary: Enterprise grade BI dashboard giving executives real time visibility into KPIs, emerging trends, and predictive analytics.
featured.problem: Executives don't want twelve dashboards. They want one screen that tells them what's about to break.
featured.approach: Layered forecasting and anomaly highlights directly into the executive view. KPI tiles drill into trend explanations, not just numbers. Predictive models surface this is going to miss target before quarter end, not after.
highlights: Single executive surface across revenue, operations, customer health
Predictive analytics layered onto KPI tiles
Drill throughs with explanations, not just numbers
Weekly leadership cadence as the design constraint
outcomes: Reviewed weekly by senior leadership
Shifted reporting from descriptive to predictive
Anchored revenue, churn, and engagement conversations in one place

featured.name: ML Churn Prediction
featured.tagline: Ensemble model and CRM retention triggers
featured.summary: Production ML system predicting customer churn with automated retention campaign triggering. Ensemble modelling, deep feature engineering, CRM integration.
featured.problem: Marketing knew customers were churning. They just didn't know which ones, when, or why. By the time the dashboard showed it, the customer was gone.
featured.approach: Engineered behaviour, usage, and support features, trained an ensemble of Random Forest and Gradient Boosting, exposed scores via API, and wired the high risk segment directly into CRM retention triggers, so prediction became action.
highlights: Ensemble of Random Forest and Gradient Boosting
Behaviour, usage, and support signal feature engineering
CRM integration. Predictions trigger retention campaigns
Production deployment, not a notebook
outcomes: 27% improvement in retention interventions
Identified at risk customer cohorts proactively
Closed the loop from model output to outreach

featured.name: Smart IT Support Automation
featured.tagline: Seventy percent plus ticket auto resolution
featured.summary: Production ready IT support automation that auto resolves IT tickets with a 70% plus resolution rate.
featured.problem: L1 IT tickets are repetitive: password resets, VPN, mailbox permissions, printer drivers. Every minute of human time on those is a minute not spent on real incidents.
featured.approach: Classifies inbound tickets, matches against a runbook library, and executes safe remediations against AD, O365, and device management APIs. Tickets the system isn't confident on get routed to a human with full diagnostic context attached.
highlights: Inbound ticket classification with confidence scoring
Runbook driven safe auto remediation
Human handoff includes pre collected diagnostics
Built around real L1 and L2 categories, not synthetic ones
outcomes: Seventy percent plus ticket auto resolution
Faster MTTR on the remaining human handled tickets
Frees senior IT for engineering work

featured.name: Network Intrusion Detection
featured.tagline: ML based intrusion detection on network flows
featured.summary: Machine learning network intrusion detection system trained on labelled flow data to spot intrusions in real traffic.
featured.problem: Signature based IDS misses anything novel. Pure anomaly detection over fires. You need a model that learns flow behaviour without melting on benign traffic.
featured.approach: Feature engineered network flow records, trained classifiers on labelled intrusion data, and tuned thresholds against false positive cost, not just precision.
highlights: Flow level feature engineering
Supervised classifier trained on labelled attacks
Threshold tuning against analyst time cost
Foundations for hybrid signature and ML detection
outcomes: Detects novel patterns signature engines miss
Operates on per flow features, not raw packets
Tuned for analyst workload, not just F1

featured.name: Cyber Vault
featured.summary: Secure interface to manage, track, and trade cryptocurrencies. Designed for both first time and experienced users.
featured.problem: Most crypto interfaces are either traders' cockpits or onboarding wizards. There's no clean middle that respects both.
featured.approach: Built a layered UI. A low cognitive load entry surface that promotes the right info first, with progressive disclosure for power features. Security cues like key handling and confirmation steps are visible without being noisy.
highlights: Progressive disclosure UI. Beginner default, power user on demand
Portfolio tracking, transaction view, market data
Security conscious confirmation flow
Responsive design for desktop and mobile
outcomes: Removes the cliff between beginner and trader UIs
Surfaces security context where it matters
Modern interface for portfolio and market view
